proposals: MNRE should maintain a public, quarterly-updated register of green hydrogen and derivative projects under the National Green Hydrogen Mission, giving state, developer, capacity in MW and tonnes a year, and status from announced to commissioned or dropped, so the national map does not depend on a 2024 task-force list in which a third of rows lack capacity.

The Odisha Industries Department should publish one consolidated list of green hydrogen and derivative projects approved by the state, with approval dates and investment, so the 9-project ₹1,53,000 crore and 12-project ₹84,918 crore rounds can be reconciled and duplicates removed.

MNRE should report each year under the SIGHT scheme the electrolyser manufacturing capacity actually commissioned against the 3,000 MW awarded, and the green hydrogen actually produced against the 862,000 tonnes a year contracted, with incentives paid, so agreements and delivered output are not counted as the same thing.
